title: Fix Fish Speech MLX DAC codec loading and reference resampling
description: Fish Speech MLX model failed to load audio decoder weights from codec-mlx/model.safetensors, causing post_load_hook to use uninitialized random DAC weights and generate silent/blank audio (-40 dBFS). Fix codec path loading to codec-mlx, resample reference audio to 44.1kHz, and regenerate production audio.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed Fish Speech MLX DAC codec loading by loading FishS1DAC from codec-mlx/ directory instead of root snapshot. Resampled reference audio to 44.1 kHz. Added amplitude normalization safeguard in _to_wav. Synthesized 74s commencement speech audio with serious voice at full volume (-1.4 dBFS peak) and uploaded to S3 (37a5f620.wav) and updated DynamoDB. Landed via PR #55.
